name: Shenzhen Boshijie Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Boshijie Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of intelligent hardware products for the Internet of Things in China. It offers smart payment hardware; smart sleep terminals; electronic student ID cards; smart wearable watches; portable error correction printers; pet tracker; security cameras; passenger car on board terminals; commercial vehicle terminals; GPS tracker; wireless communication modules; AI dashcam and MDVR; smart fleet accessories; and IoT locks. In addition, it provides fleet management software. The company's products are used in cold-chain transportation, mining-truck, mining truck, oil and gas delivery, small van,…
